data.desc: Hyliion develops and builds modular power plant technology designed to deliver reliable, flexible, and affordable electricity. Its KARNO technology operates on a range of fuels, helping customers adapt to an evolving energy landscape. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with research and development in Cincinnati, Ohio, Hyliion is initially focused on data center, military, commercial, and industrial applications for its KARNO Power Module, which can provide prime power directly at customer sites. Beyond commercial power, Hyliion will deploy its technology in military applications, including unmanned vessels, command posts, and forward operating bases. The Company's mission is to enable reliable, flexible, and scalable electricity production through innovative and practical solutions that meet customers' power needs while supporting a cleaner energy future.
